name: mistakenot-skills
description: Reusable agent skills for planning, executing, and shipping software with AI agents — installable as Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: planning-workflow
plugins.description: End-to-end AI-agent task delivery: requirements, solution, plan, review, execute, and ship features through a structured plan-to-merge workflow.

plugins.name: ideation
plugins.description: Structured ideation: generate high-impact feature ideas and run synthetic user-research simulations to decide what to build next.

plugins.name: maintenance
plugins.description: Documentation maintenance: keep READMEs and docs in sync with the current state of the code.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Machine-local handoff stack: push and pull short text notes between agent sessions using a JSONL store.

plugins.name: exploration
plugins.description: De-risk ideas before building: run exploratory tech spikes that validate assumptions and stress-test approaches.

plugins.name: rich-docs
plugins.description: Author rich single-file HTML planning docs with tabs, mermaid diagrams, file-change trees, and inline comment threads.

plugins.name: reflection
plugins.description: Reflection loop: mine learnings into a diary, and observe→refine→search reusable task rules.

plugins.name: assurance
plugins.description: Design end-to-end assurance and testing strategies for autonomous agent-built software.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: External-research skills: track open-source repos and mine their updates into a ranked backlog of ideas to borrow.

plugins.name: domain-modelling
plugins.description: Build and maintain a project's ubiquitous language: a DDD glossary of canonical domain terms, kept in sync with the code.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Relentlessly interrogate a plan, design, or decision to surface assumptions and edge cases, recording the outcomes as numbered ADRs.

plugins.name: eval-engineer
plugins.description: Build, run, validate, and manage A/B evals for skills in this repo: replay real tasks, compare skill versions on cost and quality, and validate the eval before trusting it.
